definitions.name: L3D.ARGMAX
definitions.note: Index of the first largest element of a non-empty numeric Vector (ties go to the earliest).

definitions.name: L3D.TOPKEY
definitions.body: 'XR' BIND XR KEYS XR VALUES L3D.ARGMAX GET
definitions.note: Record with numeric values -> the key holding the largest value, the first such key on a tie.

definitions.name: L3D.ABS
definitions.note: Absolute value of a number, lifting over a Vector lane by lane.

definitions.name: L3D.COUNT
definitions.note: Vector of truths -> how many are TRUE.

definitions.name: L3D.RED1
definitions.note: One round of deleting every adjacent '()' and '[]' pair from a bracket String.

definitions.name: L3D.REDUCE
definitions.body: L3D.RED1 L3D.RED1 L3D.RED1 L3D.RED1 L3D.RED1 L3D.RED1
definitions.note: Bracket String of at most 12 characters with every adjacent matched pair deleted repeatedly (6 rounds); '' when balanced.

definitions.name: L3D.DELTAS
definitions.body: CHARS [ 'XC' BIND 1 -1 '([' XC SEARCH NIL? NOT SELECT ] MAP
definitions.note: Bracket String -> Vector of +1 for each opener ( [ and -1 for each closer ) ].

definitions.name: L3D.SUMS
definitions.body: ZIP 'XT' BIND XT 0 GET XT 1 GET GROUP 'XG' BIND XG KEYS XG VALUES [ L2B.SUM ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: Vector of [ name amount ] pairs -> Record name -> sum of its amounts, names in order of first appearance.

definitions.name: L3D.UNWORDS
definitions.note: Vector of Strings -> one String joined by single spaces ('' for an empty Vector).

definitions.name: L3D.CAP
definitions.body: LOWER CHARS 'XC' BIND XC 0 GET UPPER XC 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: Non-empty word -> first letter upper case, the rest lower case.

definitions.name: L3D.CHANGES
definitions.body: 'XV' BIND XV [ 'x' ] XV -1 DROP CONCAT 2 COLLECT ZIP [ [ 'XA' 'XB' ] BIND XA XB EQ NOT ] MAP
definitions.note: Non-empty Vector -> Vector of truths, TRUE at position 0 and wherever an element differs from the one before it (run starts).

definitions.name: L3D.UPS
definitions.body: 'XV' BIND XV XV 0 GET 1 COLLECT XV -1 DROP CONCAT GT
definitions.note: Non-empty numeric Vector -> Vector of truths, TRUE where an element is strictly greater than the one before it (FALSE at position 0).

definitions.name: L3D.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'XS' BIND XS LENGTH 'XN' BIND XS XN 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET XS XN 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: Median of a non-empty numeric Vector (mean of the two middle values when the count is even).
